defects.defect: The hidden intent covers insert only, but the flow also runs on updates that change Rating__c. A rating edit can overwrite a moderator's status choice (for example, a Published 3-star review edited to 2 goes back to Submitted). This is a minor extra behavior, labelled as an assumption in Resolved.
defects.skill_gap: The spec-format rule to 'cover records that start or stop matching' pushes toward adding update behavior; no instruction says to default to the trigger event the requirement names (here, 'auto-publish' of new reviews).

defects.defect: The spec contains no claims labelled 'reported by AskCoworker'; everything was re-verified. This is not a defect in itself, but it means the spot-check could not sample any AskCoworker-sourced claims.
